shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'tsconfig*' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md; ls -a'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -C 3 'navigation|table|uikit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; sed -n '355,385p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; sed -n '450,470p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh table Table useTable ColumnReorderingProvider; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Modal Checkbox Pagination; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh table Table useTable useRowSelectionFixedHandler ColumnReorderingProvider; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Modal Checkbox Pagination'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs/INDEX.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md; node -e \"for (const p of ['table','navigation','icons','uikit']) {const x=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json'); console.log(p,x.version,x.peerDependencies)}\"; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/components | rg '(Button|TextInput|Select/types|Modal/Modal|Pagination/Pagination|Checkbox/Checkbox).*d.ts"'$'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,190p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useTable.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts; sed -n '1,175p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts; sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -L -s https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html; rg -o '\"(House|Persons|ShoppingBag|Gear|Magnifier|Bell|Plus|ArrowDownToLine|ChevronDown|CircleQuestion|ArrowUpRight|Sliders|LayoutColumns|Layers|ArrowRightFromSquare|Ellipsis|CircleCheck|Clock|Xmark|ArrowRotateLeft|ChevronRight|ChevronsLeft|CreditCard|Bars|SquareChartArea)["'^"]*"'"' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | sort -u | head -65; rg -n 'g-color-(base|text)-(info|utility|positive|warning|neutral)|purple|brand' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -35"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"const r=await fetch('https://gravity-ui.com/icons'); const t=await r.text(); await import('node:fs').then(fs=>fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/gravity-icons.html',t)); console.log(r.status,t.length); console.log([...new Set(t.match(/(House|Persons|ShoppingBag|Gear|Magnifier|Bell|Plus|ArrowDownToLine|ChevronDown|CircleQuestion|ArrowUpRight|Sliders|LayoutColumns|Layers|ArrowRightFromSquare|Ellipsis|CircleCheck|Clock|Xmark|ArrowRotateLeft|ChevronRight|ChevronsLeft|CreditCard|Bars|SquareChartArea)[A-Za-z]*/g))].slice(0,90))\"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -175; rg -n -A 80 'CSS|--gn-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | tail -100"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/types.d.ts | head -180; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head -140; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/columns/selectionColumn.js 2>/dev/null; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm | rg 'selectionColumn|base.d.ts|TableSettings.d.ts'; sed -n '95,166p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import fs from 'node:fs';const s=fs.readFileSync('/tmp/gravity-icons.html','utf8'); for(const q of ['house','persons','shopping-bag','magnifier','layout-columns','arrow-down-to-line','layers','bell','circle-question','sliders','chevron-down','ellipsis','arrow-up-right','circle-check','clock','xmark','plus','gear','calendar','arrow-right-from-square']) {const i=s.indexOf(q);console.log(q, i>=0?s.slice(Math.max(0,i-45),i+q.length+80):'not found')}\"; sed -n '1,195p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/types/base.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.js; rg -n -A 22 'LogoProps|MenuItem' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -100; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/TableSettings/TableSettings.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(house|persons|shopping|gear|magnifier|bell|plus|arrow-down|chevron|circle-question|arrow-up-right|sliders|layout|layers|ellipsis|circle-check|clock|xmark|calendar|arrow-right-from)' | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts | head -195; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/TableSettings/TableSettings.js | head -110; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -75; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/variables.css 2>/dev/null; sed -n '96,125p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useTable.js | head -100; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(Persons|ShoppingBag|Magnifier|Sliders|ArrowDownToLine|LayoutColumns|CircleCheck|Clock|Bell|Layers|Xmark|CreditCard|ArrowUpRight|ChevronDown|ChevronRight|ChevronLeft|ChevronsLeft|House|Gear|Plus|CircleQuestion|Ellipsis)\\.(js|d.ts)"'$'"' | head -60; rg -o -- '--gn-aside-header-(min|max)-width["'^;'"\\}]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -8; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/TableSettings/TableSettings.js | head -85"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--g-color-(base-utility["'^: ,;]*|text-utility[''^: ,;]*|base-neutral[''^: ,;]*|base-float[''^: ,;]*|line-utility[''^: ,;]*|text-light[''^: ,;]*)'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u; rg -o -- '--gn-aside-header-[a-z-]+:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | sort -u | head -35; rg -n 'className|renderGroupHeader|GroupHeader' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.js | head -30; cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,185p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.css; cat vite.config.ts; cat package.json; git diff --stat; node --version"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'enableColumnReordering|setColumnOrder|columnOrder|handleDragEnd' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/ColumnReorderingProvider.js | head -125; rg -n -C 2 'selection|rowSelection|group' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.js; rg -n 'getIsAllRowsSelected' node_modules/@tanstack/table-core/src/features/RowSelection.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'ColumnDef|types/base' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/index.d.ts; sed -n '1,170p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/hooks/useRowContent.js; sed -n '1,115p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/ColumnReorderingProvider.js; sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseHeaderCell/BaseHeaderCell.js; cat .gitignore"

/bin/bash -lc "tail -40 /tmp/contour-ssr-warnings.log; git status --short; rg -n 'renderGroup|isGroupHeader' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '115625,115700p' /tmp/contour-smoke.cjs; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/CompositeBar/CompositeBar.js; head -25 node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/House.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | head -60; sed -n '18,65p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'getIsGroupHeaderRow' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.js; head -20 node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/House.js; head -15 node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm/House.js; rg --files node_modules/react-virtualized-auto-sizer | head -12; rg -n 'AutoSizer' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/CompositeBar/CompositeBar.js | head -7"

/bin/bash -lc "tail -24 /tmp/contour-ssr-warnings.log; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.js | head -115; rg -n 'getIsGroupHeaderRow' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/hooks/*.js; sed -n '90,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.js"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/.bin; rg -n -C 4 'columnOrder|handleReorder|columnPinning' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/hooks/useColumnDrag.js | tail -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Content/Content.js | head -60; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/Layout/Layout.js 2>/dev/null | head -65; npm run build"
